CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(CaseId__c), NULL,
IF( NOT(ISBLANK(CompletionDate__c)),
IF( CompletionDate__c > DueTime__c, "Breached", "Resolved" ),
IF( CaseId__r.IsClosed,
IF( DueTime__c < CaseId__r.ClosedDate, "Breached", "Resolved" ),
IF( DueTime__c < NOW(), "Breached", "OnTrack" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Current Status
